test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E and F are six retired international cricketers who are sitting next to each other in a row in a TV show. E and F are at the extreme ends of the row. C is second to the left of E. B is second to the right of F. A is to the immediate left of B. D is to the immediate right of C. Who is at the fourth position from the left?
solution:
A, B, C, D, E and F are six retired international cricketers who are sitting next to each other in a row in a TV show.

1) E and F are at the extreme ends of the row.

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7cfc421f190fd92e6b1ede74aa5117b40b3f3244d428c66ecda2248abc7f881.png] 

Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acea20db4b37655dc93e2703d4771680109aac86b9ea334b2904ff2a358372f9.png] 

2) C is second to the left of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57845ecb3fc8f653d68ae311ffc40107d609063b991ad5f0a800e47493d6eea3.png] 

3) D is to the immediate right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0265641292b84504585d3b8f2f9d9c7588fea9831330530fb0b64aaaa2d75b2.png] 

4) B is second to the right of F and A is to the immediate left of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12a16d3737a8ce7166f3251a443b539b76a226ede9cac1d5e7b8904d8d5b997d.png] 

∴ Here. 'C' to the fourth position from left.

Hence, the correct answer is **"C".**
